paragraphs: Pusheen the Cat makes the leap from internet icon to video game star. Pusheen’s Place is now available exclusively on Apple Arcade, giving fans a cozy new way to spend time with the famously adorable feline.
Apple launched the game on October 1 alongside four other additions to Apple Arcade: River City Survivors, Terraria+, Touchgrind BMX 2+ and 4 Pics 1 Word+.

Pusheen’s Place lets players build their own Pusheen paradise while collecting more than 100 different kitties. Players can craft and decorate rooms for characters including Pusheenicorn and Pancake Pusheen, then take a break with mini-games such as Snack Stack, Parfait Pop and Batch Match.

Pusheen’s Place is the first officially licensed game starring Pusheen. It joins Apple’s growing collection of so-called cozy games, which emphasize relaxation and self-expression rather than the violent themes common in more traditional titles. Other cozy games on Apple Arcade include Hello Kitty Island Adventure and Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom.

Cozy games not your thing? Apple Arcade has you covered. River City Survivors brings the long-running River City series into the survivors-like action genre. The game throws players into waves of zombies, with flashy special moves and randomized upgrades helping them build a stronger run each time.
More than 20 characters are playable, including series favorites Kunio and Riki, while players can recruit up to two companions to join the fight.
Developed by Arc System Works, River City Survivors arrived on Apple Arcade October 1.
